required_runtime_gates.pass: custom loading screen appears instead of vitaGL splash and reports phase, elapsed time, estimated remaining time, resources, GPU textures, shader warmup, audio warmup, and cache status
audio is present from boot/menu and remains present during race and post-race screens, with preload summary showing warmed bank and sequence counts
first race start has no visible resource, audio, texture, or shader hitch after shader and CI/TLUT preload summaries are present
raceplay remains locked at 60 fps on configured PS Vita OC profile
post-race score screen is smooth on first entry
no right-edge or bottom-edge retained-frame artifact, grey bar, or reflected strip
image and text quality are acceptable at fixed 1/2 render scale without sacrificing locked 60 fps
after closing and reopening the app on PS Vita hardware, preload-ready marker evidence exists and the second launch does not reintroduce first-exposure shader/resource hitches
Vita Kart 64 icon, LiveArea/startup art, and loading-card identity are packaged and visible without official-looking Nintendo/Sony branding

diagnostic_order_if_failed: collect preload-summary.txt and shader-warmup-summary.txt from the supervised run
if there are visible hitches without texture misses, run exactly one supervised frame-hitch diagnostic build
if texture misses are proven, merge only supervised hardware-discovered pairs into the persistent overlay
if presentation artifacts return, freeze performance changes and fix viewport/scissor/presentation policy first
